product_block: The product is the Shnuggle Toddler Bath, copied exactly from reference image 1 (real product photo) and reference image 2 (six real views of the same tub): a white plastic toddler bath tub with a smooth matte finish, an egg-shaped rounded body, a wide rolled rim that rises higher at the back, a light grey foam backrest panel inside the back wall with a faint embossed shnuggle logo, a small embossed MAX fill-line mark low on the inside wall, a light grey oval logo badge on the front outside reading only the lowercase word shnuggle (no registered mark, no other text), a smooth, plain, matte white contoured inside floor with a single smooth raised oval seat bump shaped like a soft rounded pillow (one oval, not two lobes) (no dots, no holes, no circles, no pattern anywhere on the tub), and small light grey foot pads under the base. Copy its shape, proportions, colours, logo badge and backrest exactly; the tub is shown alone and stays empty and dry.
nothing_added: Do not add anything to the product or around it: no plug, no knob, no drain stopper, no handle, no seat insert, no water, no bubbles, no toys, no towel, no bottles, no stickers, no dots, holes or printed pattern, no extra text or labels. No people, no hands, no children. Nothing else at any edge of the frame.
look: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 smartphone photo of a real home bathroom: pale powder-blue square wall tiles with white grout, light grey stone floor tiles, white fixtures and chrome taps. Bright soft natural daylight from a window, neutral white balance, clean and bright, no yellow or warm cast, no dark or moody shadows, sharp focus on the tub.

size_block: TRUE SIZE (from the maker's drawing): the tub is 68 cm long and 49 cm wide at the rim, 39 cm wide at the base, 39 cm tall at the front rising to 54 cm tall at the back. That is a compact tub: its highest point is about knee height on an adult and only a little above a toilet seat; on 30 cm floor tiles its base is about one and a half tiles wide. Reference image 3 is a real photo of this exact tub standing in a real family bath: copy that true size relative to the bath, taps and room, NOT anything else from that photo. Do not make the tub bigger or taller than this; keep its proportions exactly as in reference images 1 and 2.
